name: Sid Barricade
acting: Hard lateral gaze and open shouted syllable.
personality: Gives useful directions at a volume that makes them hard to follow.
bio: Sid reroutes foot traffic whenever a HyperNorm scene acquires an inconvenient view.
note: He pointed me toward the authorized exit. It was behind the authorized entrance.
call: This way. The other this way.

name: Iris Tackspark
acting: Uneven eyes follow the spark, lower lip tense.
personality: Patient with steel and impatient with management.
bio: Iris welds up loose seams in the HyperNorm perimeter. She leaves the bad ones visible until someone initials them.
note: Her weld held. The initials cracked immediately.

name: Cal Valvegrip
acting: Doubtful side-eye, puffed cheek and off-center frown.
personality: Knows exactly which leak somebody will call condensation.
bio: Cal services the pipes that feed reassurance into the HyperNorm estate. He has yet to find the return line.
note: I reported a drip. He asked whether I meant the pipe or the committee.

name: Bert Bluecoat
acting: Relaxed lids and a gleeful one-tooth grin.
personality: Finds an alarming number of applications for the same blue.
bio: Bert repaints the parts of town the Men in Black prefer to describe as undisturbed.
note: The first coat covered the damage. The second covered the date.

name: Mira Leadloop
acting: Raised gaze and small pursed lips.
personality: Treats an unexpected live wire as a colleague who has spoken out of turn.
bio: Mira found the emergency sign wired to the circuit it was supposed to warn about. She left a note with a very neat diagram.
note: The sign came back on before anyone read the note.

name: Pip Ridgehook
acting: Worried downward gaze and small dry grimace.
personality: Prefers rooflines that stay where he last saw them.
bio: Pip tiles the HyperNorm façades that appear overnight after a cleanup. He secures the lowest roof tile first.
note: He told me the view was fine. He hadn't looked at it.
